# Public API surface of the runtime-provided packages.
# GENERATED by tooling/scripts/api-surface.mjs — do not hand-edit.
#
# These exports change underneath already-deployed bundles when the fleet
# is moved onto a new image. Removing one breaks tenants at boot.
